decisions: Retain PHA/PLA/JSR/RTS coverage and committed pure control-tail regions.
Reject resident-only chain entry: +196480 code-cache bytes for only 0.02123 percentage points whole-app improvement over selected.
Reject opcode-cost admission: both standalone and combined measurements lose to their matching base.

design: Preserve all CPU/PPU and Mapper synchronization boundaries.
Batch four sprite/background decisions with byte masks; retain full sprite buffer and sprite-zero/overflow behavior.
Track the sprite row coverage alongside the sprite row and use original spork consumption.
Use a content+height checked OAM row index only after two successive fetches agree; dynamic OAM takes the original linear scan.

resolved_fixture_failures.resolution: The old fixture demanded native credential after 6 PPU cycles (96 units), which never crosses the preexisting >96 admission gate. Preserved that C path with explicit no-native and exact state assertions, then added 7 cycles plus actual native entry assertion before all original DMW/credential/state checks.

The old warm-up used only 1 PPU cycle and could never heat a block. Default warm-up now uses 7 cycles; a separate 1-cycle case verifies no native entry, no counter/heat change and exact state. Original compile/reuse/invalidation assertions retained.

combined_dynamic_oam.scope: Test-owned ROM writes OAM continuously; all MIPS core bytes unchanged; full state/PCM/video exact
combined_dynamic_oam.applicability: Measured before the two version-string bytes changed; executable and writable sections unchanged

limitations: Executed MIPS instruction counts do not measure physical H1 cycles, FPS or audio quality.
Complete-application firmware services are mocked; full firmware coverage is the title/menu/reload flow.
Dynamic OAM stress retains about 1.09 percent extra core cost; no universal game speedup claim.
The diagnostic firmware runs each reported one underrun; these separate runs are not performance comparisons.
Commercial ROM, firmware dump, NAND and audio remain local and are excluded from install packages.
